action_items: RESOLVED by testing agent (minor fix): /app/backend/routes/lead_gen.py lines 339 and 366 had unescaped double-quote `(never say "attached")` inside double-quoted strings, which produced SyntaxError and prevented the backend from starting (502 at ingress). Fixed by escaping the inner quotes with backslash. Please confirm the message wording is still what you intended; the semantics are unchanged. Without this fix, the entire backend was down for this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: mira_outreach.pitch_preview correctly falls back to _SAMPLE_LEADS[vertical] when no real candidate matches _candidate_query — good; is_sample flag exposes this to the UI.
_clean_notes keeps only {salon, restaurant} string keys and enforces 1500-char cap — matches spec.

put_settings uses merged=cur|{non-None body fields} then rewrites verticals/wa_countries/hunt_countries/followup_days/pitch_notes — this means pitch_notes always goes through _clean_notes (safe), and partial updates don't nuke the other vertical since _clean_notes reads merged.pitch_notes which came from `cur` when body omitted it (verified by test).

mira_hq.mira_pipeline builds totals{salon,restaurant} independent of the vertical filter — but under ?vertical=restaurant totals.salon will always be 0 since salon leads are excluded upstream. Not a bug per spec, but Boss expects to see 'Total salons/restaurants in system' at a glance regardless of the vertical filter; consider running a separate countDocuments for totals. (Low priority.)
_wa_message correctly produces the Bablu founder intro with '30 days FREE', '/signup-{vert}', and '/demo'. '90' is explicitly absent from _WA_FEATURES/body — verified in decoded wa.me URL.

lead_gen.py had TWO unescaped double-quote `"attached"` tokens inside double-quoted strings (lines 339 & 366). This is a trivial dev-time bug but it means backend wouldn't boot — recommend adding a `python -m py_compile routes/lead_gen.py` pre-commit hook.

edit_lead at line 1119 sets email_source='manual' only when a new email is provided — verified: PUT /super-admin/mira-leads/{lid} {email:'owner.test@gmail.com'} returns email_source='manual' in the lead doc.

FollowUpPipeline frontend treats WA button as <button>+window.open rather than <a href>; this means right-click 'Open in new tab' won't yield the pre-filled message, and middle-click won't open. Consider rendering as <a href={wa_link} target="_blank" rel="noopener"> for a11y + keyboard/middle-click parity. (Low priority.)

pitch-preview-lead badge shows 'sample lead — no pending restaurant lead' when is_sample=true — matches spec. For salon with 51 pending leads the badge would show 'next real lead' (not re-verified in UI since preview DB had a sample path; worth a second pass once a restaurant lead is seeded).
